6.raw_text: I will be as dew to Israel: he shall bloom as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Libanus.

7.text: His branches shall spread, and he shall be as a fruitful olive, and his smell shall be as [the smell] of Libanus.
7.raw_text: His branches shall spread, and he shall be as a fruitful olive, and his smell shall be as [the smell] of Libanus.

8.text: They shall return, and dwell under his shadow: they shall live and be satisfied with corn, and he shall flower as a vine: his memorial shall be to Ephraim as the wine of Libanus.
8.raw_text: They shall return, and dwell under his shadow: they shall live and be satisfied with corn, and he shall flower as a vine: his memorial shall be to Ephraim as the wine of Libanus.

9.text: What [has] he to do any more with idols? I have afflicted him, and I will strengthen him: I am as a leafy juniper tree. From me is thy fruit found.
9.raw_text: What [has] he to do any more with idols? I have afflicted him, and I will strengthen him: I am as a leafy juniper tree. From me is thy fruit found.

10.text: Who is wise, and will understand these things? or prudent, and will know them? for the ways of the Lord are straight, and the righteous shall walk in them: but the ungodly shall fall therein.
